picks.name: DJ Jackum
picks.bio: "Context" (August 14, 2026) is a six-track album on Hotflush Recordings -- Floo, Clip Empty, Take Your Body Higher, Prang, Step Up, and a closer -- described by the label as six tracks of heavy bass pressure.
picks.why_listen: Dense, weighty bass music built for the low end -- useful when you need to shift a set from house/techno territory into something rougher and more sub-driven.

picks.name: Posthuman
picks.source_note: UK electro/acid duo, similar territory to Legowelt/DJ Plant Texture already in your seeds; new label discovery (I Love Acid / Balkan Vinyl).
picks.bio: UK duo running the I Love Acid party/label. "Gang of 404" (July 3, 2026) is an 11-track album -- What U Need, Test 14, Reps, Another Earth, Torus Dreams, Break Bones, Chronophobe among them -- steeped in sci-fi themed Detroit and UK electro.
picks.why_listen: Squelchy, sci-fi-leaning electro and acid in the same lineage as your Legowelt/DJ Plant Texture picks -- good for a darker, more machine-driven stretch of a set.

picks.name: Alex Nut
picks.source_note: Broken beat/soul-jazz-house territory similar to your Carlos Niño & Friends pick; new label discovery (Eglo Records, which he co-runs).
picks.bio: Rinse FM DJ and co-founder/curator of Eglo Records. "The Heat EP" (July 24, 2026) is a four-track 12" -- Bright (feat. Steve Spacek), a Bright Re-FreQ Mix, the title track The Heat (feat. Allysha Joy), and Duck Duck (feat. Sam Crowe).
picks.why_listen: Warm, groove-and-feeling-first broken beat that sits well next to your Carlos Niño & Friends pick -- a good late-set cooldown that still moves.
